title: Retailers urge end to tax exemptions for online purchases

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government should scrap the tax-free threshold for international online purchases instead of revising levies on luxury goods, the head of the national retailers group said on Wednesday, warning that the current e-commerce regime creates an uncompetitive environment for local businesses. Bobby Claudio, chairman of the Philippine Retailers Association, said removing tax exemptions on cheap online purchases would generate more revenue for the government than taxing luxury items, as the Marcos administration pushes a broader tax overhaul that includes hiking levies on luxury goods. “If there’s one revenue area that the government can look at, it’s there.
